clauses.title: Scope – Covers the
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Covers the dimensions, such as length, measurement for wood based panel materials. The wood based panels considered are plywood, blockboard, hardboard, fibre insulation board, particle board, veneered particle board, particle board for insulation and high density particle board.
